    - heading "Understand Segment" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A segment is the finite set of points between two endpoints. From (0,0) to (5,0) the length is 5, and (6,0) is not on the segment. A line would continue past B. You can learn Segment by trying one small example instead of long theory.
